node.title: Do I need to use defined?
node.author: IruP
node.doctext:
2017-10-07 Note added by [Athanasius]: This node was copied from [https://stackoverflow.com/questions/46077157/do-i-need-to-use-defined|StackOverflow]. See also [id://1198857].

Is there any difference between these 2:

print "Undefined\n" unless defined $test;

and

print "Undefined\n" unless $test;
